meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). Uses real Chrome with CDP to bypass anti-automation. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到 X 平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布推文和长文到 X。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to X platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post tweets and articles to X.

howto.what: 通过真实 Chrome 把文字、图片、视频、Markdown 长文章发布到 X,可先预览再发布;也能引用推文并附评论,首次使用需手动登录。
howto.when: 当你说“post to X”“tweet”“publish to Twitter”等,或要求分享到 X 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这张图片和这句话发布到 X（先预览）
say.note: 会打开浏览器预览发布内容。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 文章发布成 X Article
say.note: 要求 X Premium,可加封面。

say.text: 引用这条推文并评论：说得好
say.note: 生成带评论的引用推文。

howto.what_en: Posts text, images, videos, and Markdown long-form articles to X via real Chrome; previews before submitting. Also supports quote tweets. Manual login required on first run.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or asks to share on X.

say_en.text: Post this image with this caption to X (preview first)
say_en.note: Opens browser to preview the post.

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown file as an X Article
Quote this tweet with comment: well said
say_en.note: Creates a quote tweet with your comment.
